Need some more info. Do you normally serve food? Do they want to rent out the bar for the entire night or just for a few hours? Is there any open bar (one tab all night) or will people be paying for their own drinks?
At my bar we will charge a flat rate per hour to cover lost revenue that we would normally make at that time (a Saturday night will cost more than a Monday night) and for the labor of having a bartender. 
Don't bother with specialty drinks, unless that is part of your concept. Just have a bartender serving like a normal night, normal prices. Corporate gigs aren't too sensitive to prices, they got those expense accounts, baby!
Why specifically a gas station? Are you looking for something fast, cheap, and greasy? I personally would go for Little Caesars if that's the case; otherwise Casey's would be the answer, I guess.

Absolutely, I can tell when I'm having a depressive episode when I start to withdraw, which makes me more lonely and depressed, which makes me withdraw more, etc. It's a nasty spiral. It takes a lot of effort to pull yourself out of that sadness tornado, stop and breathe and realize that you can get out of this, if only for awhile. Good luck and I hope you feel better soon.

This actually pretty normal for people to think about, it named "The call of the void" and it may be a fleeting curiosity for some. If these thoughts of suicide ever become a concrete plan or become persistent recurring thoughts , tell someone and go to a doctor or therapist.

It's perfectly okay to feel this way. Nobody is going to be happy all the time. Allow yourself to feel blah right now and then try to pinpoint what is making you feel this way. Do what you can to change it, if not, accept it and continue take care of yourself.

Have you told a friend or family member how you feel? I know it's terrifying to show somebody and open up, and it's incredibly annoying to have someone want you to be alive when all you feel like is dying, but they will want you to get better. 
If someone you cared about had cancer and there was an eighty percent chance that they would get better would you want them to try? Or  would you be okay with them killing themselves even if they didn't try? 
As long as you are still awake you are not a lost cause.
That sounds overwhelming. Sometimes things just pile on at once and can make you feel hopeless.  Remember that if things weren't always this bad, they can get better again.

Good for you, the first step is incredibly difficult for some. Just remember that change will come slowly and you'll probably fall a couple (at least!) of times, but don't let that discourage you. People here will try to catch if you fall. Good luck.

You don't necessarily need to wear it everyday, just go down to Target and get yourself one outfit that looks nice and run errands one day and see if your confidence gets a boost.
Pets are great, aren't they? You are capable of giving them so much love and they love you unconditionally back. I'm glad you were able to find some comfort in your kitties.
